message.content: No mode questions, do not use Skill. Launch two Agent subagents (subagent_type general-purpose, model haiku is fine): first one in the foreground with description "count files" that runs ls and reports the count; second one with run_in_background true and description "say hi" that just replies hi. Wait for both results then reply ALL DONE.
